req.title: Player payload includes firstName and lastName
req.statement: The system shall include firstName and lastName fields on every player response.
triggers: player payload includes firstname and lastname

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-033 requires that every player response includes firstName and lastName fields. The API uses camelCase aliasing (to_camel), so the JSON keys are 'firstName' and 'lastName'. Tests must: (1) positively confirm both fields are present and non-null for a known player, (2) negatively confirm a 404 for a non-existent UUID (no payload to check), (3) boundary-test the first and last squad numbers in the dataset to confirm fields appear at edges, and (4) assert exact field values to catch mutations that rename, remove, or swap these fields.

tests.name: test_player_response_includes_firstName_and_lastName_positive
preconditions: Database contains player with id=97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802 (Anjali Banerjee, squad 1)
expected: Response JSON contains key 'firstName' with value 'Anjali'
Response JSON contains key 'lastName' with value 'Banerjee'
trace: R-PLAYER-033: firstName and lastName must appear on every player response
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_player_response_includes_firstName_and_lastName_positive():
    r = client.get('/players/97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert 'firstName' in body
    assert 'lastName' in body
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Anjali'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Banerjee'
    assert isinstance(body['firstName'], str)
    assert isinstance(body['lastName'], str)
    assert len(body['firstName']) > 0
    assert len(body['lastName']) > 0

tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_player_response_firstName_lastName_exact_values_multiple_players():
    r10 = client.get('/players/e51a3744-b879-41cb-a100-533f9d5a0bc6')
    assert r10.status_code == 200
    b10 = r10.json()
    assert b10['firstName'] == 'Kabir'
    assert b10['lastName'] == 'Reddy'
    r26 = client.get('/players/77a3ac92-52d1-48c4-871c-73988df20dc8')
    assert r26.status_code == 200
    b26 = r26.json()
    assert b26['firstName'] == 'Aditya'
    assert b26['lastName'] == 'Mehta'

tests.name: test_all_preloaded_players_have_firstName_and_lastName
actions: Send GET /players/ to retrieve all players
Assert every player object in the list has firstName and lastName
expected: All 26 players have non-empty firstName and lastName fields
No player object is missing either field
trace: R-PLAYER-033: 'every player response' — collection endpoint must also satisfy the requirement
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_all_preloaded_players_have_firstName_and_lastName():
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    players = r.json()
    assert len(players) == 26
    for p in players:
        assert 'firstName' in p, f"Missing firstName for player {p.get('id')}"
        assert 'lastName' in p, f"Missing lastName for player {p.get('id')}"
        assert isinstance(p['firstName'], str)
        assert isinstance(p['lastName'], str)
        assert len(p['firstName']) > 0
        assert len(p['lastName']) > 0
